apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: traefik-gateway
      namespace: traefik
      sectionName: websecure
      kind: Gateway

  hostnames:
    - cyberchef.${main_domain}

  rules:
    - matches:
      - path:
          type: PathPrefix
          value: /

      backendRefs:
      - name: {{ .Release.Name }}
        namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
        port: {{ .Values.service.main.ports.main.port }}

      filters:
        - type: ExtensionRef
          extensionRef:
            group: traefik.io
            kind: Middleware
            name: chain-forwardauth

apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: minio-admin-creds
  namespace: {{ .Release.Namespace }}
  labels:
    homelab/backup-resource: "true"
spec:
  refreshPolicy: OnChange
  dataFrom:
  - sourceRef:
      generatorRef:
        apiVersion: generators.external-secrets.io/v1alpha1
        kind: ClusterGenerator
        name: "password"
  target:
    template:
      metadata:
        labels:
          homelab/backup-resource: "true"
      data:
        username: "minio"
        password: "{{ `{{ .password }}` }}"
      engineVersion: v2
